Preflight Demo Program
DEMO-PROGRAM-ALPHA
DOC-0051 2026-09-18
RETROSPECTIVE — A Reopen Request Without Its Return
Reason
Date: 2026-09-18
Program: DEMO-PROGRAM-ALPHA
Recorder: PERSON-0012, TEAM-0006
What happened A cabin desk request asked for an earlier discussion to be
brought back but omitted why it needed another hearing. The receiving clerk
could find the old question, yet could not tell what administrative point the
requester wanted reconsidered. ISSUE-0048 and TASK-0198 locate the folder
used in this paperwork retrospective.
What helped The records clerk preserved the earlier question rather than
editing it to match the new request. The reviewer could therefore ask the
requesting coordinator for a distinct explanation. Keeping the request separate
also prevented the desk conversation from being treated as evidence of a
record transition.
What changes
Apply the return-note rule to the request: retain the earlier question and place
a separate dated return reason beneath it. The coordinator must explain the
new administrative question and why the earlier note does not answer it. Add
the named reviewer and intended discussion date before handing the request
to the receiving desk.
If the explanation is missing, the collecting clerk returns a precise question to
the requester and records the next contact time. The clerk must not invent the
reason from a short subject heading.
Follow-up PERSON-0012 will review the revised request layout on 2026-09-21.
The training copy will show distinct spaces for the earlier question, new
reason, reviewer name, and next discussion appointment.
D. Worker 0012
Demo Worker 0012, Demo Team 06
